full_judgment:
3. The suit of the plaintiff case is that the land described in Schedule-"Ka" of the plaint was belonged to the R. S. record of tenant and on successive transfer ultimately Zafar Ahmed became owner by purchase and possessed the same. The area of R.S. Plot No.95 is 1.37 acres and the area of land described in Schedule-"Ka" of the plaint is .37 decimals of land. Zafar Ahmed being owner in possession sold the same to the plaintiff by a registered kabala dated 30.08.1976 on proper consideration and put the plaintiff in possession over the "Ka" Schedule land and since then the plaintiff has been in exclusive possession and the name of the plaintiff has been mutated by separating the jama in Mutation Case No.2649/1991-92 and his name was also recorded in the B.S. Khatian by order dated 09.06.1992. The plaintiff for his exclusive use constructed the boundary walls in all sides of the "Ka" Schedule land and also put barbed wires on the wall running from North to West and north to south and the plaintiff also has his own path way connecting the Government Road. The plaintiff also constructed a tinshed semi pacca house having iron pillars at the western side of the suit plot and in the thatched fencing tinshed house darwans are residing. The plaintiff also sinks a tubewell for drinking water and planted coconut trees, bamboo trees and also used to cultivate seasonal crops. Since the date of purchase of the "Ka" Schedule land the defendants have been trying to grab the property and for that end and view they started conspiracy. The plaintiff resides away from the suit land and taking this advantage the darwans and other employees of the plaintiff have been threatening to dispossess by the defendant for which the plaintiff submitted application to the Deputy Commissioner, Police Commissioner and other authorities informing about the illegal activities of the defendants. The plaintiff also got his land measured through Additional Deputy Commissioner, Revenue and the defendants threatened to demolish the plaintiff's new constructed wall and house. On measurement of the area of land it was found correct that there was a path way from North to South by the eastern side of the suit plot from the time of his predecessor Jafar Ahmed for public use. The defendants have no right title and interest and also possession in any manner in the suit land. The plaintiff took loan from Agrani Bank, Agrabad Hotel Branch by mortgaging the "Ka" Schedule land. The defendants have been threatening to dispossess and also have been creating obstruction in the use of the path way and as such the plaintiff constrained to file the suit for perpetual injunction. 

 4. The defendant No.1 appeared and contested the suit by filing written statement and also denied the material allegation made in the plaint by the written statement and it has been stated that the plaintiff has no cause of action for filing the suit and the suit is not maintainable. The suit is barred by limitation and further stated that the defendant No.1 is a Co-Operative Housing Society which was established in 1975 and in order to solve the acute housing problem of the City Dweller of Chittagong and with that end and view he purchased the vast land for this noble purpose. The defendant also obtained permission from Chittagong Development Authority to cut hills on 04.07.1975 and got passed the layout plan for constructing the building over the land of the defendant and C.D.A. also approved the said plan on 25.10.1976 and gave permission to cut hill of the extended area. Zafar Ahmed sold 1(one) acre of land out of R.S. Plot No.95 by kabala dated 31.08.1976 to the defendant No.1 and handed over possession accordingly and B.S. Khatian has been published in his name. The plaintiff also purchased .37 decimals of land from the said Zafar Ahmed and entered into an agreement with the defendant No. 1 in order to develop the land after cutting hill and the plaintiff became member of the society and in lieu of two plots of the society he had relinquished his claim over .37 decimals of land in favour of the defendant No.1 in the first part of 1983 and accordingly handed over the possession of the said land to defendant -1 and also assured the defendant No.1 to pay Tk.10,000/- towards development cost and also assured to pay more money if necessary. The defendant developed the land along with the said .37 decimals of land allotted to one Mustafa Younus Noor, M.A. Matin, Md. Shafi Ahmed, Md. Shamsuddin, and Dilruba Jahan and accordingly executed the lease deed in favour of those persons and as per the terms of agreement the defendant kept one plot for the plaintiff. The plaintiff also wrote a letter to that effect on 07.04.1985. There are few plots in the schedule land and also a pathway over the suit land as per layout plan and the defendants also made all arrangement for taking water and electricity connection for the use in the plots. The defendants also guarding to protect the society land and properties, But one Abdul Hamid instituted a suit claiming 67½ decimals of land against the defendant as plaintiff in the Court of Assistant Judge in 1987 being Other Suit No.70 of 1987 and the plaintiff in spite of service of summons did not appear in that suit but defendant contest the suit and ultimately the suit was dismissed for default. The plaintiff on ill advised by one Mintu and also finding that the value of land has substantially been increased due to the development made by the defendant, hence the plaintiff filed the suit and as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
